name: B10-0078/2026 (S&D) – Attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the attempted takeover of Lithuania’s public broadcaster and the threat to democracy in Lithuania
part_text:
Lithuania's parliament is considering changes to the law governing its public broadcaster, LRT. This resolution does not change any law. It sets out the European Parliament's opinion: media freedom and the broadcaster's independence matter for democracy, and any changes must respect EU media rules. It asks Lithuania's parliament to work with the Venice Commission, a legal advisory body, and to consult journalists, civil society and media groups before deciding.

- Nothing changes yet: the amendments are still being discussed and not adopted.
- It affects Lithuania's parliament, LRT and its staff, and media groups.
- Next: a Venice Commission visit on 20 January 2026, and a working group reports by 14 February 2026.
